corinthians1.9.p1.b1.text: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle?

corinthians1.9.p1.b2.text: Have I not seen Jesus our Lord?

corinthians1.9.p1.b3.text: … surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

corinthians1.9.p2.b4.text: Have we no right to take along a believing wife …

corinthians1.9.p2.b5.text: Or are Barnabas and I the only apostles who must work for a living?

corinthians1.9.p2.b6.text: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit?

corinthians1.9.p3.b7.text: “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is it about oxen that God is concerned?

corinthians1.9.p3.b8.text: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?

corinthians1.9.p3.b9.text: But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.

corinthians1.9.p4.b10.text: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel. But I have not used any of these rights.

corinthians1.9.p4.b11.text: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

corinthians1.9.p4.b12.text: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge …

corinthians1.9.p5.b13.text: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.

corinthians1.9.p5.b14.text: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. … To those without the law I became like one without the law …

corinthians1.9.p5.b15.text: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak.

corinthians1.9.p5.b16.text: I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.

corinthians1.9.p6.b17.text: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize?

corinthians1.9.p6.b18.text: Run in such a way as to take the prize.

corinthians1.9.p6.b19.text: … They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.

corinthians1.9.p7.b20.text: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.

corinthians1.9.p7.b21.text: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
